scripts.check:pkg: pnpm -r --filter './packages/*' exec publint && pnpm --filter @videodb/robopeek-rlds exec attw --pack . --profile esm-only && pnpm --filter @videodb/robopeek-react exec attw --pack . --profile esm-only --exclude-entrypoints ./styles.css ./structure.css ./theme.css && pnpm --filter @videodb/robopeek-mcap exec attw --pack . --profile esm-only && pnpm --filter @videodb/robopeek-mcap-react exec attw --pack . --profile esm-only --exclude-entrypoints ./styles.css ./structure.css ./theme.css
